about.commitmentContent:
We have the following commitments towards the bitcoin community: 
 • Remain open-source 
 • Provide high-quality educational content 
 • Translate our content in as many languages as possible 
 • Support Bitcoin entrepreneurs in their journey
about.coreTeamContent: Plan ₿ Network is a collective of hundreds of contributors, teachers, community leaders, designers, developers, and organizers. Special thanks go to the numerous people who have made Plan ₿ a reality and continue to do so each day. (Wall of contributors coming soon)
about.corporateContent: Plan ₿ Network is the joint project of three entities focused on Bitcoin development. In an effort to make the Bitcoin education layers scale, they decided to collaborate to form Plan ₿ Network. Since then, many other entities have decided to contribute and join forces to help us bring Bitcoin education to the world. For this reason, a huge thank-you is due to them.
about.description: Plan ₿ Network helps communities worldwide to get organized in order to provide better education. The platform develops the necessary tools towards that goal, through the online academy, the tutorials portal, the Bitcoin educational toolkit and the resource portal.
about.manifesto:
We believe in the decentralized future that Bitcoin offers.

Our mission is to introduce Bitcoin to a billion people by a decade's time. Our tools are education and information. 

We support local communities of Bitcoiners by providing open-source educational content and offering a network of Bitcoin mentors.

Our philosophy is inspired by the cypherpunk manifesto. Just as they championed privacy, we champion education. In fact, we believe that knowledge is the foundation of freedom and change.

We are Bitcoin-only. 

We advocate for individual responsibility and the independence offered by owning your own keys. 

We urge verification, not blind trust. 

We believe that by fixing the money, we can fix the world.

We are decentralized and open-source, avoiding any single point of failure. 

We encourage the free dissemination of our content. 

We aspire to a world that operates from the bottom up, where the individual is at the center.

We simplify, we educate, we share. 

Join us in our mission to orange-pill the world.
about.missionContent1: Our mission is to support local Bitcoin communities through open-source education and networking. In order to do it, we collect, organize, and create the necessary resources (courses, books, posters, flyers, videos) for the Bitcoin industry to advance.
about.missionContent2: We centralize knowledge so we can share it in the best possible way, using a simple, multilingual GitHub repository and an E-learning platform. We also assist local Bitcoin hubs in their development by providing the right tools for their talents to grow.
about.storyContent: Plan ₿ Network is an initiative that supports Bitcoin education worldwide. It's the crossover of various passionate Bitcoin companies focused on education, open-source software, peer-to-peer networks, and the sense of community. Together, they've decided to build the Plan ₿ Network and offer the Bitcoin ecosystem the right tools to grow. Our 2023 release presentation is available here.

guideContent.guideline10P1: Sharing educational content requires effort and courage. Feedback and criticism are therefore welcome **only if they are constructive, respectful and relevant**. Therefore, personal attacks or harmful comments will not be tolerated.
guideContent.guideline11P1: Any contents or comments that promote **hate, discrimination or harassment are forbidden**. This includes remarks targeting race or skin color, religion, culture, origin or any other personal attribute.
guideContent.guideline12P1: Treat everyone with respect. Healthy and constructive debates are encouraged, but courtesy is essential. Please also respect people's privacy and do not share personal information without consent.
guideContent.guideline1P1: Content shared in the Educator Content section must be directly related to Bitcoin, including its educational, economic, privacy, security or self-sovereignty aspects. Off-topic content may be moderated or removed.
guideContent.guideline2P1: Upload files that you believe will benefit the Bitcoin community at large, especially for education purposes. The goal is to gather resources that can serve educators and communities teaching Bitcoin around the world.
guideContent.guideline2P2: Please avoid uploading files that have a very low probability of being used by others. Too many irrelevant files make it harder to find valuable content.
guideContent.guideline2Title: 2. Share content that is useful to others
guideContent.guideline3Bullet2: How you have been using it
guideContent.guideline3Bullet3: How others might use it in their own context
guideContent.guideline3P1: Resources are much more impactful and useful when they are clearly named and described. Please provide context in your content description to help others understand:
guideContent.guideline3P2: Also, choose your cover image carefully and make sure it represents the content accurately.
guideContent.guideline3P3: When uploading files, use descriptive file names. The file name will be visible to other users when they download your content. Avoid generic names like "final_v2.png". Instead, use clear names that describe the content, such as "bitcoin-basics-workshop-slides.pdf".
guideContent.guideline4P1: The Educator Content section is designed for knowledge sharing and collaboration. To ensure readability and fair visibility, we encourage you to group related files together. For example, a series of presentations will have more visibility and impact as a curriculum, rather than as individual presentations that are hard to connect. Bundles make it easier for other educators to find and use complete sets of materials.
guideContent.guideline5Bullet1: **Share links** to editable or duplicable resources (Canva, Google Slides, Figma), so other educators can adapt your work to their needs
guideContent.guideline5Bullet2: **Attach multiple file formats** (PDF, PNG, source files), so others can choose the format that works best for them
guideContent.guideline5P1: For each resource, you can attach both links and files. This gives you the opportunity to:
guideContent.guideline5P2: This flexibility makes your content more useful to a wider audience.
guideContent.guideline6P1: If you are adding content you did not create, the original source must be credited in the description. The content must also be shared under the same license it was originally published with.
guideContent.guideline6P2: When you upload content to the Educator Content portal, it is linked to your Plan ₿ Academy account. You are responsible for the content you share. Sharing copyrighted material without proper authorization is not allowed and will be subject to moderation.
guideContent.guideline6P3: **Only upload content you have the right to share.**
guideContent.guideline7LearnMore: Learn more about Creative Commons licenses
guideContent.guideline7Licenses: CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-ND, MIT
guideContent.guideline7P1: All content is published under the CC-BY-SA license by default.
guideContent.guideline7P2: If you wish to apply a different license to your content, you can select from the following options:
guideContent.guideline7P3: If you are not familiar with licenses, you can safely keep the recommended default option (CC-BY-SA).
guideContent.guideline8P1: Promotional content is not allowed in the Educator Content section. This includes:
guideContent.guideline8P3: Do not upload material that could be considered spam, scams, or that contains misleading information.
guideContent.guideline9Bullet1: **If there are minor errors:** We will take the initiative to correct them directly.
guideContent.guideline9Bullet2: **If the content cannot be accepted without major corrections:** We will reject the submission.
guideContent.guideline9P1: Once you submit your content for review, our team will check that it follows these guidelines.
guideContent.guideline9P2: In both cases, whether your content is accepted or rejected, you will receive a notification by email.
guideContent.intro: Thank you for being here! This guide will help you understand how to share your educational materials with the global Bitcoin educator community.
guideContent.purposeP1: The goal of the Educator Content section is to help Bitcoin educators support each other and reduce duplicated work. This way, no one has to start from scratch every time they prepare a presentation or educational material.
guideContent.purposeP2: We know how much effort and energy educators put into creating content for their local communities. We believe this content can be extremely valuable for other educators doing the same work around the world.
guideContent.purposeP3: The idea is to be stronger together: better content, better distributed, and less time wasted recreating what already exists.
guideContent.whatYouCanShareEditable: **Editable versions:** Canva links, Google Slides, source files (so others can adapt and customize)
guideContent.whatYouCanShareFileTypes: **Supported file types:** Images, PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, text documents
guideContent.whatYouCanShareP1: In the Educator Content section, Bitcoin educators and communities can share and distribute their content, as well as download materials created by others.
guideContent.whatYouCanShareP2: The content can take many forms:
guideContent.whatYouCanShareP3: Content can be shared in any language, either as:
guideContent.whatYouCanShareStatic: **Static files:** PDF, PNG, JPG (ready to use or print)
